{{Quote|I've been hearing about a Mon Calamari called Ackbar, a slave we rescued from the Eriadu system.|[[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], to [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]|<ref name="TFU2n" />}}
In the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the newly-formed [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the Alliance '''attempted''' to capture [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] in the [[Eriadu system/Legends|Eriadu system]]. Though they were unable to capture Tarkin, Alliance forces rescued his [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], a man who went on to become the Alliance's most influential military leader in its history.

==Prelude==
When word that [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]] would be traveling with [[Bevel Lemelisk]] to the first Death Star reached the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], they launched an operation to capture the pair. The Rebels planned to assault a group of [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]], including Tarkin's shuttle, that were en route to [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] [[Vehemence (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Vehemence'']] in the [[Eriadu system/Legends|Eriadu system]].

==The battle==
In order to make it more difficult for Tarkin to be discovered in the event of an ambush, five ''Lambda''-class shuttles were to take the trip from Eriadu to the Death Star, with Tarkin and Lemelisk riding one with the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Epsilon 5 (Galactic Empire)|Epsilon 5]]. The shuttles were escorted by six [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]], three each from [[Alpha Squadron|Alpha]] and [[Beta Squadron/Legends|Beta]] squadrons.<ref name="X-Wing" /> However, Tarkin deliberately arranged not to travel with a full compliment of guards because he felt it allowed him to move unhindered and avoided drawing attention to the Death Star's location.<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref> The shuttles departed from the [[Eriadu Governor's Palace]], with Ackbar piloting the Epsilon 5,<ref name="Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> and Tarkin and Lemelisk beside him in the passenger seats.<ref name="Darksaber" /> As the shuttles approached the ''Vehemence'', three [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] launched into the system and began their attack, escorted by several X-wings. The starfighters engaged and destroyed the TIEs,<ref name="X-Wing" /> while the Y-wings opened fire on the escort shuttles with their [[KX5 laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].<ref name="Darksaber" />

Tarkin ordered Ackbar to take evasive action. Instead, he calmly shut down the shuttle's shields, with the intention of allowing the ship to be destroyed, killing Tarkin and Lemelisk along with himself.<ref name="Darksaber" /><ref name="Moons" /> Red Three identified Epsilon 5 and determined Tarkin was aboard,<ref name="X-Wing" /> and the Y-wings fired precision shots that struck the rear of the shuttle and sent it spinning uncontrollably. Ackbar taunted Tarkin and informed him he was going deliberately allow their death out of revenge for all the pain Tarkin had caused him and others of his species.<ref name="Darksaber" /> Tarkin and Lemelisk fled to an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], purposely leaving Ackbar to his likely death.<ref name="Darksaber" /><ref name="Moons" /> They launched the pod, which shot away spinning violently into space, and activated a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]]. The pod was only intended for one occupant, so the two were uncomfortable and suffered minor injuries from the flight, with Lemelisk breaking his nose.<ref name="Darksaber" /> Meanwhile, the Y-wings continued firing on Epsilon 5 until it was disabled.<ref name="X-Wing" />

Once the shuttle was disabled, ''Hasti'' entered the system from hyperspace and arrives with the commando unit, with two Y-wings from Blue Squadron providing escort. The ''Vehemence'' launched nine additional TIE fighters &ndash; three each from Alpha, Beta and [[Gamma Squadron/Legends|Gamma]] squadrons &ndash; to engage the Rebel starfighters, and the Red Squadron Y-wings joined Blue Squadron in engaging the TIEs and providing cover for ''Hasti''. The ''Hasti'' successfully boarded Epsilon 5, where they discovered Ackbar still alive, but found that Tarkin and Lemelisk had escaped.<ref name="X-Wing" /> The two Imperials watched the shuttle get boarded and expressed surprise that they would bother rescuing Ackbar, who Tarkin regarded as a "worthless alien."<ref name="Darksaber" /><ref name="Moons" />

Before the Rebels could turn their attention to Tarkin's escape pod, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]] arrived in the system with his flagship [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]],<ref name="Darksaber" /> which was the [[Steel Talon/Legends|''Steel Talon'']] at the time,<ref name="Death Star novel">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> despite Tarkin not having requested his assistance for the escort. The Star Destroyer began firing its [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] at the Rebel forces,<ref name="Darksaber" /> which prevented them from pursuing and capturing the escape pod.<ref name="Moons" /> Once Ackbar was safely removed from the Epsilon 5, the Y-wings opened fired on the shuttle again and destroyed it.<ref name="Darksaber" /> The Rebels then went into hyperspace and fled the system,<ref name="X-Wing" /> leaving Motti's Star Destroyer to rescue Tarkin and Lemelisk.<ref name="Darksaber" />

==Aftermath==
The rescue of Ackbar and his knowledge of the Death Star overshadowed the Alliance's failure at [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], and he was returned to his people as Admiral of the Mon Calamari fleet. Like many planetary resistance groups, the Mon Calamari were initially cautious with the Alliance to Restore the Republic, but Ackbar provided unofficial support and gave tacit approval of the decision by some Mon Calamari to pledge their starships to [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma's]] cause.

Because of the historical importance of Ackbar's rescue and recruitment into the Rebel Alliance, it was made into a simulation for [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]], a simulation that [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] briefly took part in.<ref name="X-Wing" />

==Behind the scenes==
The liberation of Ackbar was first described in the [[1987]] first edition of ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'', which established that Ackbar was Grand Moff Tarkin's slave and was rescued when an elite Rebel force attacked Tarkin's shuttle as it embarked to the Death Star. The location where this conflict took place was not identified in that book.<ref name="SWSB">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> In the [[1991]] ''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]'' it was further specified, that the attack happened during the flight from [[Eriadu]] to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], without going into detail where exactly on this route the attack happened.<ref>''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref> The battle itself was first featured in the [[1994]] ''Collector's CD-ROM'' edition of the [[LucasArts]] computer game [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']], which it was the last of six "historical missions" that could be played with the Y-wing star-fighter.<ref name="X-Wing" /> This battle was later featured again in the [[1995]] novel [[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']] by [[Kevin J. Anderson]]. In that book, which was set in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], Bevel Lemelisk recalled the event through a flashback. It was this book that first specified the setting of the Eriadu system,<ref name="Darksaber" /> which was later reaffirmed in the books ''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'' (1995),<ref name="The Essential Guide to Characters">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> and ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'' ([[1998]]).<ref name="Moons" />

A separate, conflicting account of Ackbar's liberation was described in the [[2006]] LucasArts computer game ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'', in which Ackbar is [[Raid over Corulag|rescued from one of Tarkin's research stations]] orbiting the planet [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]].<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref> However, this version of the event is not considered [[canon]], as Ackbar's having been rescued during an assassination attempt against Tarkin has been upheld in several ''Star Wars'' reference books, including ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' ([[2002]]),<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Characters">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' ([[2005]]),<ref name="EssChron">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' (2008).<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
